caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular ornamental carpet or textile with an elaborate design. The outermost edge of the carpet has a muted greenish border, followed by a thick twisted rope-like border in beige and grey. Inside this, there is a dark grey area which sets off an inner rectangular section filled with light beige color. The central area of the carpet is richly decorated with vibrant floral motifs; clusters of flowers in colors such as pink, red, purple, yellow, blue, and green are distributed in symmetrical arrangements. Around the flowers, there are large, swirling red and maroon leaf-like designs filling the corners and framing the central floral cluster. The central bouquet of flowers is more densely packed, featuring a variety of flowers and leaves. The composition emphasizes symmetry and integrates both curvilinear and swirling forms, with the color palette dominated by reds, greens, pinks, and accentuated by various secondary colors. The background on which the carpet is drawn is light beige without any additional objects or patterns.
title: Hooked Rug
